description:
Hey! I'm into gaming and space, especially Moon and Mars exploration. I enjoy games involving survival, adventure and exploration, and I'd love to bring some of that inspiration into a Space Apps project.

I've got basic coding knowledge and I'm keen to learn more, particularly about game development and working with NASA data.

I'm mainly hoping to take on a project solo, but I'm open to connecting with fellow gamers, developers, designers and space enthusiasts to share ideas or collaborate.
